about: Review N9: every request the v1.0.0 game client (tag v1.0.0, commit 0716643) sends, as it sends them. v1.0.0 has no tests/client_requests.json (it was added after), so this copy was recorded from v1.0.0's own game/src/api.ts with the Vitest recording of game/test/requests.test.ts (fetch stood in for; every request a POST of JSON, with the Bearer session once there is one). scripts/compat-check.sh replays it against the new backend when the previous release is v1.0.0. Placeholders as in tests/client_requests.json: $TOKEN (a fresh launch token), $UUID (a new id), $NEXT (the cursor from the history answer before; skipped when there is none).
